Enjoy a No-Hassle Grain Delivery Experience
Our Grain Division stands as a beacon of trust and reliability in the agricultural industry. Our dedicated team handles, stores, and transports grain efficiently and securely. We understand the importance of your harvest and are committed to providing seamless grain solutions. From precise handling to timely delivery, our Grain Division ensures that your hard work is respected and rewarded. Partner with us for a seamless grain experience that guarantees the best value for your yield.
Horizon Resources’ Grain Division operates a 110 car, concrete shuttle loading facility in Williston. Our terminal features two driveways, which can each receive grain at 20,000 bushels per hour and has two dedicated shipping legs capable of 54,000 bushels per hour combined capacity. Our terminal is supported by four sub-stations located in Watford City, Grenora, Zahl and Alamo, North Dakota.
Our Grain division is proud to be a beacon in the agricultural industry. You can expect seamless grain solutions when you team up with us.
On the spot grading is offered at all Horizon Resource Facilities
Williston Grain Elevator Expansion — Coming 2027
Growing Our Capacity. Improving Efficiency. Serving Producers Better.
Horizon Resources is investing in the future of agriculture in our region with a major expansion of our Williston Grain Elevator , scheduled to open in 2027 .
The expansion will add approximately 740,000 bushels of grain storage capacity , giving area producers greater access to efficient, dependable grain receiving and handling services.
Designed to improve the movement and handling of commodities through the facility, the expanded elevator will enhance our ability to receive canola and spring wheat while adding dedicated space for canola at the terminal .
Expansion Highlights
740,000 bushels of additional capacity
Expanded Williston grain elevator
Improved efficiency for commodity receiving and handling
Enhanced canola and spring wheat receiving
Additional terminal space dedicated to canola
Anticipated opening in 2027
Investing in the Future of Local Agriculture
As production and marketing needs continue to evolve, Horizon Resources is committed to investing in infrastructure that helps our local producers operate more efficiently.
The Williston Grain Elevator expansion will provide additional capacity, improved grain-handling capabilities and greater flexibility during busy harvest and delivery periods—all while continuing the dependable service producers expect from Horizon Resources.
Opening in 2027. Stay tuned for construction updates and additional project information.
